title: 課程 syllabus 下載手冊（Brochure）API + 前端串接
content: CourseCard 與 CourseDetailView 現有「Download Brochure」按鈕但無實際功能。本卡片實作 GET /api/courses/[slug]/brochure 端點，從資料庫讀取課程資訊（名稱、描述、時數、講師）及 syllabus items（模組單元、主題、時長），產出可下載的 HTML 手冊（後續可升級為 @react-pdf/renderer PDF），並將 CourseCard 與 CourseDetailView 的按鈕接上真實下載。
userStory: 課程 syllabus 下載手冊

findings: CourseCard.tsx:204-210 has <button> with title={dict.downloadBrochure} but onClick is undefined — no-op
CourseDetailView.tsx:436-443 has <a> with href={course.brochureUrl || '#'} — always points to '#'
types.ts:60 has brochureUrl?: string in Course type, but map-course-detail.ts never populates it
SyllabusItem model in Prisma schema has all fields: moduleNumber, titleZh/titleEn, duration, topicsZh/topicsEn, sortOrder
evidence.residual: Initial implementation uses HTML brochure (no extra npm deps). PDF generation via @react-pdf/renderer can be added as a follow-up.
